summary.intent: Add branch as a real scope kind for memory loop records, plus scope filtering in both the Memories tab and Settings tab of the memory loop TUI, so users can control which scopes get injected at runtime.
summary.outcome: Fully implemented: ScopeKindBranch added to data model, refresh now produces branch-scoped records, injection pipeline supports per-scope filtering via functional options, TUI Memories tab has S-key scope filter with cross-filtered counts, Settings tab has toggleable injection scopes card, all 5 new tests pass.

repo: Memory loop records are stored in a single .entire/memory-loop.json file; scoping is a property of each record, not separate files.
Branch scope was previously only a refresh-time concept (which sessions to analyze), not a storage concept — records were always written as repo or me scope.
SelectRelevant uses a functional options pattern (SelectOption) for backward-compatible API extension — all existing callers continue to work without changes.
The memorylooptui already existed at cmd/entire/cli/memorylooptui/ before this session; the feature was adding scope filtering to an existing TUI.
Lint failures in skilldb/discovery are pre-existing and unrelated to memory loop changes; ireturn lint issues are expected from the bubbletea pattern used throughout the codebase.
strategy package was already imported in lifecycle.go, making branch resolution straightforward to add.

code.finding: InjectionScopes uses omitempty so existing JSON files without this field deserialize to nil, treated as 'all scopes allowed' for backward compatibility — no migration needed.

Cross-filtered counts require splitting matchesFilter into two independent helpers — one for status dimension, one for scope dimension — so each can count independently while the table applies both filters.
toggleScope prevents empty injection scopes: at least one scope must remain enabled, so removing the last active scope is a no-op to avoid silently injecting nothing.
buildMemoryLoopSelectOpts resolves current git branch dynamically at injection time — distinct from refresh-time branch resolution in memory_loop_cmd.go.
scopeKindForRefresh previously returned ScopeKindRepo for branch mode; changed to return ScopeKindBranch so refresh --scope branch now produces branch-scoped records.

workflow: Build check before writing tests caught zero compilation errors, validating the approach before investing in test coverage.
Staging only feature-specific files during commit avoids accidentally including unrelated in-progress changes from other files in the worktree.
Scoped test runs (running only changed packages) provide fast feedback and distinguish pre-existing failures from regressions.

friction: Initial confusion: user expected memory loop scope options (repo/me/branch) to be visible in the skill TUI, but they were CLI-only flags — required clarification before planning could begin.
Pre-existing lint failures (ireturn in skilldb/discovery) added noise when verifying the linter was clean after changes.
Pre-existing test failures in skilldb/discovery required verifying they were not caused by the new changes before proceeding.
open_items: scopeKindForRefresh is unexported and has no direct unit test coverage; the test was added at the CLI package level as a workaround.
The ireturn lint issues throughout the bubbletea TUI code are pre-existing tech debt that is not addressed.
Pre-existing test failures in skilldb/discovery package were noted but not investigated or fixed.
